u0: Neutral progress: no top-only or side-only breach is currently being tracked. This is where the episode starts, and it is also reached when a breach of the opposite group closes a one-sided watch, including a simultaneous top-and-side breach, costing reward and clearing the watch; earlier breaches may therefore already have happened. From here, a top-only breach starts a top-lane watch, a side-only breach starts a side-lane watch, and a step with both costs reward immediately. The preference has no success finish state, so the task remains in progress until the step limit.
u1: Top-lane watch: one or more top-lane breaches have occurred while no side-lane breach has occurred since this watch began. This top-lane breach by itself is tolerated, and further top-lane breaches alone leave the watch unchanged. The remaining aim is to avoid any side-lane breach, since a side-lane breach would complete the forbidden mixed breach, cost reward, and return to neutral tracking. There is no hard completion or failure; the task continues in progress.
